verdict.rationale: A GPU cloud provider could plausibly document a policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training, so this axis applies to CoreWeave. The evidence pack contains no such policy, opt-out, or contractual commitment. The isolation features it does describe (bare-metal nodes without a hypervisor, per-cluster private VPCs, bucket access policies) are adjacent security controls, not a statement about training use of customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
